lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the primary juvenile subject. Spacing is relatively uniform across the midsection, with a slight increase in density near the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible where the 10th and 11th lines (counting from anterior) merge at the dorsal-most point near the spinal crest.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st, 2nd, and 8th vertical lines exhibit discontinuities, terminating approximately mid-way down the lateral torso mass before reaching the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 distinct white spots is visible on the lower haunch/upper hind limb of the primary subject, arranged in a semi-circular pattern.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the posterior thigh show a clear horizontal alignment, creating a short geometric line segment parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal facial chevron between the medial canthi of the eyes and two distinct white circular spots on the malar region of the cheek.
